title: Longest Palindromic Substring
summary: For a given string s, identify and return the longest substring that reads the same backward as forward.
statement: For a given string s, identify and return the longest substring that reads the same backward as forward.
constraints: When several longest palindromes exist, return the leftmost one.
hints: A palindrome grows symmetrically from either one character or a gap.
Expand around every odd and even center while the two characters match.
Keep a candidate only when it is strictly longer, preserving the leftmost tie.
Every palindrome has exactly one such center, so one expansion discovers every candidate.
editorial: Every palindrome has exactly one such center, so one expansion discovers every candidate.

tests.explanation: Both bab and aba have length three; the leftmost answer is bab.
The even-length center between the two b characters yields bb.
